theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_idx_coset_row_card
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], (∀ r s : ZMod N, (∃ x y : ZMod N, x * r + y * s = 1) → ∃ A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, (A 1 0 : ZMod N) = r ∧ (A 1 1 : ZMod N) = s) → let P := Quot (fun v w : {v : ZMod (N) × ZMod (N) // ∃ x y : ZMod (N), x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1} => ∃ u : (ZMod (N))ˣ, (u : ZMod (N)) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : ZMod (N)) * v.1.2 = w.1.2); let Q := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N; Finite Q ∧ Nat.card Q = Nat.card P
theorems.natural_summary: The bottom-row map identifies right cosets with unit-scaling classes. Coset inversion transfers this equivalence to left cosets, yielding finiteness and equal cardinality.
